steps.en: After rights clearance, configure a vault and launch your agent
steps.zh: 权利核清后，配置笔记库并启动助手

steps.en: Build a startup briefing from goals, active work and open tasks
steps.zh: 按目标、工作和待办生成简报

steps.en: Describe a meeting and the decision you need to retain
steps.zh: 描述会议及需要保留的决策

steps.en: The instructed agent files the meeting as linked notes
steps.zh: 模型把会议内容写成关联笔记

value.en: Work context stays in human-readable linked notes instead of only in a chat
value.zh: 工作背景留在可阅读的关联笔记里，不只留在聊天中
